entries.title: What is a CRM framework?
entries.summary: A CRM framework supplies the machinery a CRM application is built from — records, workflows, policies, audit — rather than a finished application you sign up for.
entries.metaDescription: A CRM framework supplies the machinery a CRM is built from — records, workflows, policies and audit — rather than a finished app you sign up for.

sections.heading: The definition
body: A CRM framework is a code library that generates or hosts the moving parts of a CRM — records, workflows, approval policies, audit — leaving the application itself to be assembled per process.

boundaries: A definition page: it claims no capability the ledger does not carry.
